name: APIVerveTextLemmatizer
summary: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms.
description:
Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return full word-by-word mappings.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Text Lemmatizer from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
